issue_title: Llama3 Tokenizer always appends "eos_id" for tokenize_messages
issue_body: Llama3Tokenizer `tokenize_messages` method calls `truncate(tokens, self.max_seq_len, self.eos_id)` at the end of the method regardless of whether add_eos is True or False. `truncate` will add eos_id everytime self.eos_id is passed to it. There should be two fixes,  only truncate when `len(tokens) > self.max_seq_len`, and only pass `self.eos_id` to truncate when `add_eos` is True.
problem_statement:
Llama3 Tokenizer always appends "eos_id" for tokenize_messages
Llama3Tokenizer `tokenize_messages` method calls `truncate(tokens, self.max_seq_len, self.eos_id)` at the end of the method regardless of whether add_eos is True or False. `truncate` will add eos_id everytime self.eos_id is passed to it. There should be two fixes,  only truncate when `len(tokens) > self.max_seq_len`, and only pass `self.eos_id` to truncate when `add_eos` is True.
